scope.permissionBody: It belongs to another workspace, or you are not assigned to it.
scope.unavailableTitle: This page could not be loaded
scope.offTitle: This tool is not open yet
scope.offBody: It is switched off in this preview. Nothing was changed and no credit was used.
scope.quotaBody: The list stays available. Nothing extra was saved.
scope.quotaUsedBody: You have used this month's allowance for this action. It renews with your plan; nothing extra was saved.
scope.closedBody: Booking and employer checkout stay closed until commercial terms are set. This is not AI feedback.
scope.notFoundBody: That record was not found. Nothing was changed.
scope.providerBody: This needs the AI service, which is not available right now. Nothing was charged.
scope.invalidBody: Check the fields and try again.
scope.businessMetaDescription: Invite staff and candidates, assign counsellors, share an opportunity queue and see totals.
scope.consent: This person agreed to be in this workspace.
scope.servicesMetaDescription: Human reviews and coaching are coming soon. Nothing is sold yet.
scope.servicesReviewScope: A person reviews material you choose.
scope.servicesNote: This is a person, not AI feedback. Booking stays closed until commercial terms are set.
scope.bookingClosedBody: Booking is closed for now. Nothing was charged.
scope.servicesSoonBody: Named reviewers and coaches will review the material you choose to share, with a stated scope, turnaround and price before you book. Nothing is sold until providers and prices are agreed; your plan does not include a human review.
scope.employerSoonBody: A separate employer product will let verified employers see only people who opted in, and contact them only with permission. It is not for sale yet, and a Business workspace never makes candidates visible to employers.
scope.checkoutClosedBody: Employer checkout is not for sale yet.
scope.developerMetaDescription: Test and live API keys with rate limits, and a brand line that keeps FlacronCV in the attribution.
scope.developerHelp: An API key is created only after the API package is on the account. The raw key is shown once.
scope.keyOnce: Copy this key now. It is not shown again.
scope.apiPackageMissing: Creating a key needs the API package add-on on this account.
scope.whiteLabelMissing: Saving a brand needs the white-label add-on on this account.
scope.rateLimits: Each key is limited to {test} requests a minute for test keys and {live} for live keys. Test keys never spend paid reads.
scope.formsMetaDescription: Prepare a supported form and review it yourself. FlacronCV does not send it.
scope.formsSoonBody: A browser helper that fills application forms you have reviewed is not available yet. Nothing on this page uses a credit.
scope.mapSoonBody: The visual map will show opportunity locations (approximate) once a map provider is connected. Until then nothing is charged and the list below has every listing.
scope.consentRequired: Confirm that this person agreed before inviting them.
scope.roleOwnerScope: You manage candidates, staff, assignments, reports and billing for this workspace.
scope.roleManagerScope: Managers handle candidates, staff, assignments and aggregate reports. They do not see billing.
scope.roleCounselorScope: Counsellors see only candidates assigned to them, and only what each candidate chose to share, plus the shared opportunity queue.
scope.roleBillingAdminScope: Billing administrators see invoices, plan purchases and usage totals, never candidate documents.
scope.assignRequired: Choose a counsellor and a candidate.
scope.businessPlanTitle: Career-services workspaces are part of the Business plan
scope.businessPlanBody: You are not in a workspace yet. If a team invited you, open the link from your invitation. To run your own, see the plans.
scope.seatsLine: Staff seats: {staffUsed} of {staffSeats}. Active candidates: {candidatesUsed} of {activeCandidates}. Archived candidates do not count.
scope.inviteSent: Invitation emailed. It expires on {date}. You can also share this link:
scope.inviteNotSent: Email is not connected yet, so nothing was sent. Share this link yourself; it expires on {date} and works only for the invited address.
scope.candidatesNoneAssigned: No candidates are assigned to you yet.
scope.archiveBody: {email} keeps their own profile, but receives no workspace services (assignments, recommendations) until reactivated. The seat is freed.
scope.reactivateBody: {email} will use one active-candidate seat again.
scope.sharedFacts: {count, plural, =0 {No confirmed profile facts.} one {# confirmed profile fact.} other {# confirmed profile facts.}}
scope.notShared: This candidate has not chosen to share their material with staff.
scope.candidateInviteHelp: The person signs in with this address and accepts. They keep and manage their own profile; inviting them never makes them visible to employers.
scope.removeStaffBody: {name} loses access to this workspace immediately. Candidate records stay as they are.
scope.queueHelp: Opportunities the team is tracking. Recommend one to an active candidate; they decide whether to apply.
scope.usageHelp: What is left this period for the whole workspace (plan plus packs). Totals only.
scope.invoicesEmpty: No purchases recorded on this workspace.
scope.reportHelp: Counts only. No names, documents or outcomes of individual candidates.
scope.myWorkspacesHeading: Workspaces you joined as a candidate
scope.myWorkspacesHelp: Your profile stays yours. Choose whether staff may see the material you marked shareable, and leave at any time.
scope.shareWithStaff: Let assigned staff see my shareable evidence and confirmed-fact count
scope.leaveBody: Staff will no longer see anything you shared. Your own profile and documents are not changed.
scope.joinMetaDescription: Accept an invitation from a career-services team.
scope.joinHelp: Accept only if you expected this invitation. It works for the email address it was sent to, and you can leave later.
scope.joinNoToken: This link is incomplete. Ask the workspace for a new invitation.
scope.joinInvalid: This invitation has expired, was revoked, or was already used. Ask for a new one.
scope.joinWrongEmail: This invitation is for a different email address, or your address is not verified yet.
scope.joinDoneStaff: You joined the workspace as staff. Open Business to start.
scope.joinDoneCandidate: You joined as a candidate. Your profile stays yours; choose what to share under Business.

mobile.joinCodeHint: Paste the whole link from your invitation, or only the code after token=.
mobile.joinOpen: Have an invitation? Join a workspace
mobile.planBody: Your career plan does not include this area. The plans comparison shows which plan includes it. Nothing was charged.
mobile.soonBody: This area is not open yet. Nothing is sold or charged here.
mobile.lockedTitle: Career tools are not active on this account
mobile.areasHelp: Every area is listed: available now, coming soon, or not included in your plan.
mobile.devSoonTitle: The developer API is coming soon
mobile.codeOnly: This build does not know the website address, so only the invitation code is shown. The invited person can paste it in the app under Business, Join a workspace.
